system.name: LeMiCa
system.one_liner: A training-free cache scheduler for diffusion video generation that picks the cached steps as a lexicographic minimax path in an error-weighted DAG.

content.variant_note: a mechanism band (legend, timestep DAG, three cache-schedule rows) above a 3 x 3 grid of generated frames for Original, TeaCache and LeMiCa
content.argues: Choosing the cached steps from a global error-weighted path keeps generated videos close to the original while running faster than local greedy caching.
content.subject: How LeMiCa's global cache path differs from traditional local caching, and the generated frames each produces on three prompts.

encoding.marker_means: B = number of model forward steps; w_ij = error weight of a cache segment; Speed up labels give the gain per method

lessons.what_to_learn: Pair a one-glance mechanism band with an output grid: the top band shows each method's schedule as a row of coloured cells with its budget, the bottom grid shows what each schedule produced on the same prompts, under the same row names, so the eye goes from cause to effect.
lessons.suits: Efficiency or approximation methods (caching, pruning, distillation, sampling schedules) whose claim is faster with the same output quality.

evidence: each edge represents a candidate cache segment along the original sampling trajectory
evaluating cache segment impacts through multiple prompts along a fixed sampling path, creating a static directed acyclic graph (DAG)
LeMiCa outperforms traditional methods (e.g., TeaCache) in maintaining structural consistency with faster inference

summary: LeMiCa is a training-free way to speed up diffusion-based video generation by choosing which denoising steps to cache from a global view instead of a local greedy threshold. Figure 1 has two bands separated by a dashed rule. The top band explains the mechanism: a legend (No Cache, Local-Greedy Cache, Global Outcome-Aware Cache), a DAG of timestep nodes x_T to x_0 whose orange skip edges carry error weights w_ij, and three rows of coloured cache cells along a timestep axis (Original B = 30, Traditional B = 12, LeMiCa B = 10) with an arrow from the DAG to the LeMiCa row. The bottom band is a 3 x 3 grid of generated frames (bench, cat, house) for Original, TeaCache and LeMiCa, with speed-ups 2.1x and 2.64x.
summary_zh: LeMiCa 无需训练，从全局视角选择视频扩散模型中要缓存的去噪步，加速生成。图上半部分用图例、带权跳边的 DAG 和三行缓存格子说明机制，下半部分用 3×3 生成帧对比原始、TeaCache 与 LeMiCa 的画质和加速比。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The two bands are not lettered or titled, so they are recorded as bands of one drawing, not as panels (the prior pass counted three panels). In the extraction the three cache rows are one bitmap and the nine frames are separate bitmaps (10 in the digest).
